name: Nils Ušakovs, Michalis Hadjipantela - Après le § 32 - Am 95
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2027
part_text: 32a. Calls for further streamlining of the European Union’s administrative services in order to eliminate duplication and reduce unnecessary costs; emphasizes that the savings thus achieved should be reallocated to the Union’s strategic priorities, in particular border security, support for SMEs, agriculture, and research and innovation;
